sloka: भूतानि राक्षसेन्द्रेण वध अर्हेण हृताम् अपि ।न ताम् शशंसू रामाय तथा गोदावरी नदी ॥३-६४-७॥
transliteration: bhūtāni rākṣasendreṇa vadha arheṇa hṛtām api ।na tām śaśaṁsū rāmāya tathā godāvarī nadī ॥3-64-7॥

translations.english: Like the elements of Nature, river Godavari did not disclose Rama that Sita had been abducted by the king of demons who deserved death.
